name: InConJunction
blurb: Indiana's oldest volunteer-run science fiction and fantasy convention, with Artist, Author, Media, Music and Trivia Guests of Honor.
notes: InConJunction XLV (the 45th, 'Celebrating 45 Years') ran July 10-12, 2026 at the Wyndham Indianapolis Airport - before this window starts (2026-10-05). The official site still shows only the XLV program with no save-the-date for a 46th edition; a web search found only an unconfirmed third-party guess of 'mid-July 2027'. editions is left empty per the no-guessing rule.
